text: Photography is a fascinating art form that combines the technical aspects of aperture, shutter speed, and ISO settings to capture images. By adjusting the aperture, you control the amount of light entering the camera, affecting the depth of field and exposure. Shutter speed, on the other hand, determines the time light stays on the sensor, influencing the overall exposure. ISO settings allow you to adjust the sensitivity of the camera to light, further fine-tuning your image. Mastering these settings enables photographers to create a wide range of effects, from sharp, well-lit portraits to blurred, dreamy landscapes.
summary: Photography involves capturing images through aperture, shutter speed, and ISO settings, with aperture affecting light and shutter speed controlling exposure time.
